turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Yaar, I completely get your frustration! Shaadi mein 6 weeks bache hain aur college ka sabse khaas dost aise "dekhte hain" bole, toh tension aana bilkul natural hai.

Par bina puche direct ticket book mat kar. Ho sakta hai uski company mein leave ka koi scene tight ho, ya koi aur baat ho jo woh tujhse khul ke keh nahi paa raha. Agar tune book kar di aur woh phir bhi kisi wajah se nahi aa paaya, toh tujhe zyada bura lagega aur paise bhi waste honge.

Ek kaam kar, aaj shaam ko usse phone kar aur direct lekin thode pyaar se bol: 
*"Dekh bhai, teri wajah se main hold pe hoon. Teri haldi ki entry aur toast locked hai. Mujhe sach bata—leave ka issue hai, budget ka hai, ya kya scene hai? Agar flight ki baat hai toh main abhi ticket book kar raha hoon, bas dates batayein mujhe."*

Aise bolke usse ek clear option de de. Tera first year ka bhai hai, thoda haq dikhayega toh woh bhi khul ke sach bata dega! Kya lagta hai?

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Tujhe flight ke ₹9,000 ki tension bilkul nahi hai... tujhe bura is baat ka lag raha hai ki tera sabse khaas dost door khinch raha hai. Aur tera aisi situation mein hurt hona 100% valid hai.

Par ek baat soch—2 mahine pehle hi naye startup mein gaya hai. Startups mein shuru ke 3-4 mahine kitne brutal hote hain, hum jaante hain. Ho sakta hai woh severe burnout ya stress se guzar raha ho. Jab dimaag exhausted hota hai na, toh banda voice notes chhod ke two-word replies pe aa jata hai—not because he doesn't care, but because uske paas energy hi nahi hoti. 

Toh abhi shaadi aur flights ko do minute ke liye side rakh. Usse ek pyaara sa voice note bhej, shaadi ka zikr mat kar. Bas bol:
*"Bhai, main dekh raha hoon tu thoda disconnected lag raha hai. Mujhe pata hai naye startup mein bohot pressure hoga. Shaadi-waadi chhod, bas yeh bata tu theek toh hai na?"*

Pehle uski jagah samajhne ki koshish kar. Agar woh sach mein struggle kar raha hoga, toh tera yeh message sun ke woh pighal jayega aur sach bata dega.

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Tera bura lagna 100% genuine hai, yaar. Jab life ka itna bada moment ho aur jisse sabse zyada expectation ho wahi detached lage, toh dil dukhta hi hai.

Phone zaroor kar aaj raat, kyunki tujhe clarity chahiye. Par ek dost ke naate ek baat boloon? **"Haan ya na" wala ultimatum mat dena.** 

Jab banda pehle se pressure ya guilt mein hota hai aur hum usse corner kar dete hain, toh woh gusse ya pareshani mein "no" bol deta hai—aur phir baad mein dono ko afsos hota hai.

Call kar, par confrontation ke mood mein nahi, vulnerable hoke baat kar. Seedha bol:
*"Rohan, main tujhpe gussa nahi hoon, par sach bolun toh mujhe hurt ho raha hai. Tu mera college se bhai hai, haldi se leke toast tak sab tere bina adhoora hai. Par teri taraf se jo distance lag raha hai, usse main confused hoon. Agar tu nahi aa sakta toh tension mat le, main samajh jaunga, bas mujhe saaf batade taaki main tujhe baar baar pester karke awkward na karoon."*

Gusse ki jagah sach bolde ki tujhe bura laga hai. Agar uske dil mein zara bhi jagah hogi tere liye—jo ki honi chahiye—woh tujhe sahi wajah batayega.

Aaj raat baat karle, jhanjhat khatam kar. Main yahin hoon, baat karke batana kya hua!

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Teri fiancée ki baat apni jagah sahi ho sakti hai, par tera hurt hona bilkul overthinking nahi hai, yaar.

Jab tune dekha hai ki wahi banda 2019 mein ek call pe overnight bus pakad ke aa sakta hai, toh aaj uska yeh cold behavior tera dil tod raha hai. Tujhe busy hone se dikkat nahi hai, tujhe lag raha hai ki shayad priority badal gayi hai.

Par ek baat boloon? Banda wahi hai, bas 2019 aur 2024 ki life mein bohot farq aa gaya hai. Tab shayad zimmedariyan kam thi, dimaag pe utna burden nahi tha. Aaj woh shayad kisi aise phase mein ho jahan woh khud ko hi nahi sambhal pa raha.

Yeh jo "naraaz hone ki gandi feeling" hai na, yeh tujhe khaye ja rahi hai kyunki tu usse pyaar karta hai. Apne andar yeh gubbar mat rakh. 

Aaj raat jab phone kare, toh gusse se nahi... uss 2019 waale bhai ke haq se baat karna. Bas dil khol ke bol dena jo tu abhi mujhe bol raha hai. 

Baat karne ke baad tera dil halka ho jayega, I promise. Call karke batana mujhe, theek hai?
